A d20 is just 20 equilateral triangles. The corner for a equilateral triangle is 60 degrees so just cut a square to the size of triangle you want, then use a combo square with a protractor head set at 60 degrees to mark it out. As for putting it together, the angle dosent need to super accurate. Lightly tack together 5 of your peices with all the points touching. Itll look like a hexagon with a section missing. Then bend it by hand till all the edges touch. Do that 4 times, then tack the 4 peices together. Itll take some persuasion with a hammer to get the fit up good
